rect.title: LPSTB and RES input buffers: left cell LPSTB, right cell RES; each a small inverter then a two-finger inverter, so the core sees the pin level
LPSTB and RES input protection: two mirrored comb cells; left serves LPSTB, right serves RES
input buffers: CLK and E: three-finger inverter then two-finger inverter. R/W, RS, CS: chain of four inverters each, both polarities available. One more inverter at the left end
input protection: five clamp cells in order CLK, R/W, E, RS, CS; each pad reaches its cell through a resistive strip
clock driver: large transistors between VCC pad and CLK pad; buffered CLK from the input row heads this way
data bus interface: column of logic beside the D0-D7 pads
D0-D7 pad cells: eight identical cells, 1600-1735 px apart: tri-state driver with its pre-driver under the VCC band, input protection above. Located, not yet fully traced (AMB-003)
central datapath (8 x 390 px): horizontal bit-slices, 390.3 px pitch: counters, comparators and registers for the horizontal and vertical timing
right datapath (8-9 x 390 px): horizontal bit-slices, 390.3 px pitch, nearest the data bus pads
left vertical array (477 px rows): rows repeat every 477 px beside the MA pads: memory address counter and related latches
mid-right vertical array (477 px rows): rows repeat every 477 px: 14-bit registers (start address, cursor, light pen) facing the left array across the routing field
latch column (304 px rows): inverter + NOR pairs mirrored about a supply rail; pilot trace is here
row above decode array: 5 or so cells feeding the decode array
register decode: NOR array, about 18 columns at 87 px pitch by 5 row pairs: address register to R0-R17 selects
top-centre logic: random logic left of the central datapath
left-centre logic: random logic between the left array and the central datapath
top-right logic rows: two rows of gates under the test structures, near the RA/HSYNC/VSYNC pads
logic above mid-right array: small array, 4 or so columns
bottom-centre logic: random logic below the central datapath
bottom-left logic: random logic near DISPTMG/CUDISP pads
logic below decode array: random logic, includes the latch column
logic right of decode array: select-line drivers and bus control
small cell by die marking: isolated cell left of the HD46505S text
bus field: dense horizontal wiring between the left array and the rest
top-right bus field: horizontal buses under the test structures
bottom bus field: wiring along the bottom of the core
process test structures: devices labelled E, A, S, D with probe pads
die marking: HD46505S and mask revision marks
